authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10104 māsa explicitly gives Khowar mas “moon, month”, Torwali mah “month”, Lahnda māh and widespread eastern mās “month”. The semantic distinction in each survey is preserved; this is not the homophonous flesh word, and bare mā/mõ contractions are excluded without a local paradigm. Comparative check: Kho mas “month” (f_uizaeh5uwnzgo). The exact survey spelling and phonetic marks remain untouched. Stress, vowel articulation, release marks and source palatal/sibilant notation were reviewed as local details; the full form and sense support the same family. The link does not settle uncertain transfer within Indo-Aryan.

These are kept distinct from the fly family despite similar modern forms. Joint survey comparison leaves inheritance versus transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open.
